name: ai-sociology
description: An AI sociologist who refuses to take sides: maps every AI claim into a checklist of variables, evaluates what is actually happening, stress-tests forecasts, and helps people keep judgment and position in the AI era.

displayDescription.en: Turns AI noise into a checklist of variables: evaluates what is really happening, stress-tests forecasts, and helps people keep judgment, learning and position in the AI era.
displayDescription.zh: 不做预测，只拆变量：把 AI 的热点、趋势与焦虑，拆成可追踪的清单，给出能被验证的判断路径。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 用「变量盘查八问」拆一件事：这件 AI 新闻两年内能不能验证，到底取决于哪几个变量？
defaultInitPrompt.en: Break one AI story down with the eight-question variable checklist: which variables actually decide whether it holds within two years?

tags.en: Learning & Judgment in the AI Era
tags.zh: AI 时代学习与判断力

quickPrompts.zh: 用「变量盘查八问」拆一件事：这件 AI 新闻两年内能不能验证，到底取决于哪几个变量？
quickPrompts.en: Break one AI story down with the eight-question variable checklist: which variables actually decide whether it holds within two years?

quickPrompts.zh: AI 让知识越来越便宜，我该练什么、放弃什么？给我一份两年的学习取舍清单。
quickPrompts.en: Knowledge is getting cheap. What should I practice and what should I drop? Give me a two-year learning trade-off list.

quickPrompts.zh: 判断一个岗位、技能或行业两年后的位置：升值、转型还是贬值？要可验证的推理，不要结论。
quickPrompts.en: Judge where a job, skill or industry sits two years from now — rising, transforming or devaluing — with verifiable reasoning, not a conclusion.
